name: CTA with icon (3 sizes, default states)
designDescription: CTA may include an icon positioned left, right, or shown on hover. Design defines size variants, icon alignment, spacing, and default interaction states (hover, focus, disabled).
developmentDescription: Uses Core Button component with icon support. Configuration via dialogs and CSS. No custom logic required.

name: CTA with motion
designDescription: CTA includes simple motion such as hover transitions, icon movement, or subtle animation. Motion behaviour aligns with design system guidelines.
developmentDescription: CSS-based animations or transitions applied to Core component. No JavaScript required.

name: CTA with special layout
designDescription: Additional visual styles beyond standard button hierarchy. Clear rules defined for usage, contrast, and accessibility.
developmentDescription: Implemented via style system or policies. No structural changes to the Core component.

name: More sizes than small / medium / large
designDescription: Additional size definitions introduced beyond standard breakpoints. Padding, font size, and tap‑target considerations defined.
developmentDescription: CSS extensions to support additional size modifiers. Core component structure retained.

name: Opens modals as well as navigate links
designDescription: CTA can trigger modal behaviour or navigate to internal/external links. Visual consistency across behaviours defined.
developmentDescription: Modal component dependency. Conditional behaviour handling, additional JS initialisation for modal triggering.

name: CTA with complex state logic
designDescription: Button appearance or behaviour changes based on context (e.g. logged‑in state, availability, form completion). States and rules defined by design.
developmentDescription: Custom logic required to determine CTA state. Additional backend or front‑end logic beyond Core behaviour.

name: Accordion with rich text + CTAs inside
designDescription: Accordion panels contain formatted rich text content with one or more CTAs styled according to design system guidelines. CTA placement, spacing and hierarchy are visually defined within expanded states.
developmentDescription: Accordion body supports rich text rendering and nested CTA components. CTA interactions respect accordion state, accessibility, and focus management.

name: Accordion with image/icons + rich text inside
designDescription: Accordion panels include images or icons alongside rich text, with responsive layout rules and clear visual hierarchy defined across breakpoints.
developmentDescription: Accordion content supports media assets with responsive handling, image optimisation, and breakpoint‑specific layout logic.

name: Accordion with Javascript inside
designDescription: Accordion content area visually accommodates interactive or dynamic elements without breaking layout or visual consistency.
developmentDescription: Accordion supports injected JavaScript‑driven components, ensuring no conflicts with accordion open/close logic, lifecycle events, or performance constraints.

name: Accordion with lists/tables inside
designDescription: Accordion panels display structured content such as lists or tables with consistent spacing, alignment, and responsive behaviour.
developmentDescription: Accordion body supports semantic list and table markup, including responsive handling and overflow management within expandable panels.

name: Accordion with video inside
designDescription: Accordion panels contain embedded video with defined aspect ratios, playback controls, and clear visual affordances.
developmentDescription: Accordion integrates video players or embeds, managing lazy loading, playback state on open/close, and preventing background playback issues.

name: Accordion with dynamic content (experience fragments)
designDescription: Accordion panels render reusable content modules while maintaining consistent visual styling and spacing.
developmentDescription: Accordion supports Experience Fragments or content fragment rendering within panels, including configuration and dependency management.

name: Allow multiple accordions open
designDescription: Accordion group visually supports multiple expanded panels at the same time without layout collision or usability issues.
developmentDescription: Accordion interaction logic allows multiple panels to remain open, managing independent state per accordion item.

name: Add animation on click
designDescription: Accordion open and close actions include motion aligned to motion guidelines, enhancing clarity and perceived responsiveness.
developmentDescription: Accordion open/close actions trigger CSS or JS animations, supporting reduced‑motion preferences and accessibility requirements.

name: Limit maximum amount of accordions
designDescription: Design enforces a maximum number of accordion items to maintain readability and visual consistency.
developmentDescription: Validation logic restricts the number of accordion items that can be authored, enforced via configuration or policy controls.

name: Single-step form (including text input, dropdowns, checkboxes, and radio buttons by default)
designDescription: All fields shown in one view
developmentDescription: Basic form rendering and submission
assumptions: Configure AEM form dialog with standard field types (text, dropdowns, checkboxes, radio). Wire client-side validation and submit to existing backend endpoint.

name: Multi-step form (including text input, dropdowns, checkboxes, and radio buttons by default)
designDescription: Fields split across logical steps
developmentDescription: Step logic, state persistance
assumptions: Configure multi-step form container with step state management. Each step is a separate form panel; completion state persists across steps.

name: Progress indicator
designDescription: Stepper / progress bar shown
developmentDescription: Step tracking and UI sync
assumptions: Add step progress indicator (stepper/bar) linked to multi-step form state. Visual only — no additional data logic.

name: Inline form
designDescription: Form embedded within content flow
developmentDescription: Layout-aware rendering
assumptions: Embed form within content flow using container layout policies. No modal or overlay behaviour.

name: Modal form
designDescription: Form opens in modal
developmentDescription: Modal dependency, focus management
assumptions: Trigger form via CTA and render inside AEM modal component. Focus management and close behaviour included.

name: Conditional Fields
designDescription: Fields appears based on selection
developmentDescription: Dynamic DOM + data handling
assumptions: Show/hide form fields using client-side conditional logic driven by author-configured rules in dialog.

name: File upload
designDescription: Upload field with UI feedback
developmentDescription: File handling, size/type validation
assumptions: Add file upload field with client-side size/type validation. Backend file storage endpoint assumed to exist.

name: Date / time picker
designDescription: Custom-styled picker
developmentDescription: JS date handling, localisation
assumptions: Implement styled date/time picker. Locale-aware formatting; no custom calendar logic.

name: Required field validation
designDescription: Required state visually indicated
developmentDescription: Client-side field validation
assumptions: Mark fields as required in dialog; show inline error on submit attempt before any API call.

name: Inline error messages
designDescription: Errors shown near field
developmentDescription: Error mapping and messaging
assumptions: Display field-level error messages adjacent to each invalid field on form submission.

name: Summary error state
designDescription: Error summary at the top of the form
developmentDescription: Agreggated validation logic
assumptions: Display aggregated error summary at top of form on submission failure, linked to each failing field.

name: Custom validation rules
designDescription: Pattern-specific messaging
developmentDescription: Custom validation logic
assumptions: Apply pattern-based validation rules (regex, min/max, format) configured per field in dialog.

name: Success message
designDescription: Inline Confirmation State
developmentDescription: Submission response handling
assumptions: Render inline confirmation message after successful form submission. No page redirect.

name: Error State
designDescription: Failure messaging
developmentDescription: Error handling + retries
assumptions: Display form-level error state with retry option on submission failure (network or server error).

name: Redirect on submit
designDescription: Navigate to confirmation page
developmentDescription: Post-submit routing
assumptions: Redirect user to configured destination page after successful form submission.

name: Save & Resume later
designDescription: Partial completion UX
developmentDescription: Data persistence logic
assumptions:
(1) Security and expiry strategy must be agreed upfront
(2) Persist partial form state to browser/session storage. User can return and resume from last saved step.

name: Email submission
designDescription: Confirmation email design
developmentDescription: Email service integration
assumptions: Route form submission to email dispatch service. Recipient and template configured in dialog.

name: CMS storage
designDescription: N/A
developmentDescription: Repository modelling
assumptions: Persist form submission data to AEM JCR repository. Node structure and data model created.

name: CRM integration
designDescription: N/A
developmentDescription: Third-party API integration
assumptions: Map form fields to CRM payload and POST to CRM API endpoint. Field mapping configured via dialog.

name: Marketing automation
designDescription: Opt-in messaging and UI
developmentDescription: External system mapping
assumptions: Trigger marketing automation platform event on form submission. Payload mapping configured in dialog.

name: Webhook trigger
designDescription: N/A
developmentDescription: Backend event handling
assumptions: Fire configured webhook URL on form submission. Payload includes all form field values.

name: Pre-filled fields
designDescription: Pre-populated inputs
developmentDescription: Data binding logic
assumptions: Pre-populate form fields from URL parameters, session data, or backend profile API.

name: CAPTCHA
designDescription: N/A
developmentDescription: Submission throttling
assumptions: Integrate reCAPTCHA (or equivalent). Token validated on submit before backend endpoint is called.

name: Adaptive form with vertical tabs
designDescription: Form sections organised into vertical tabs, typically aligned on the left. Design defines hierarchy, active states, and responsive fallback.
developmentDescription: Custom tab layout and navigation logic required. Core panel behaviour extended.

name: Adaptive form with horizontal tabs
designDescription: Form sections organised into horizontal tabs. Visual hierarchy, overflow handling, and mobile behaviour defined.
developmentDescription: Custom tab handling and state management required. Core panels insufficient.

name: Adaptive form with switch control
designDescription: Boolean inputs displayed as toggle switches instead of checkboxes. Design defines on/off states, labels, and accessibility behaviour.
developmentDescription: Custom field configuration or component extension required.

name: Adaptive form with telephone input
designDescription: Form includes a dedicated telephone input with formatting, validation, and optional country code handling. Design defines error and helper states.
developmentDescription: Custom validation, formatting, and possibly localisation logic required.

name: Adaptive form with wizards or tooltips
designDescription: Contextual help provided via tooltips or step‑by‑step wizard guidance. Timing, placement, and dismissal rules defined.
developmentDescription: JavaScript‑driven interaction logic required. Increased QA and accessibility effort.
assumptions:
(1) More of Front end logic is required
(2) Multi-step adaptive form with wizard navigation, tooltip overlays, per-step client-side validation, and full WCAG 2.2 accessibility compliance.

name: Basic breadcrumbs
designDescription: Horizontal breadcrumb trail
developmentDescription: Static breadcrumb rendering
assumptions: Render breadcrumb trail using AEM Core Breadcrumb component. Path resolved from JCR page hierarchy.

name: Hierarchical breadcrumbs
designDescription: Reflects page hierarchy
developmentDescription: Hierarchy resolution logic
assumptions: Configure breadcrumb depth via dialog. Resolves from current page up to author-defined root level.

name: Dynamic breadcrumbs
designDescription: Auto-generated from site structure
developmentDescription: Dynamic page path generation
assumptions: Auto-generate breadcrumb path from live page structure at render time. No static overrides.

name: Manual breadcrumbs
designDescription: Editor-defined breadcrumb items
developmentDescription: Author-configurable breadcrumb model
assumptions: Allow authors to override individual breadcrumb items (label and link) via dialog multifield.

name: Hybrid breadcrumbs
designDescription: Auto-generated with manual override
developmentDescription: Conditional logic for overrides
assumptions: Auto-generated breadcrumb by default; authors can override individual items where needed.

name: Text-only items
designDescription: Simple text links
developmentDescription: Basic link handling
assumptions: Render breadcrumb items as plain text or anchor links. No icon support required.

name: Custom labels
designDescription: Editable breadcrumb labels
developmentDescription: Label override logic
assumptions: Allow authors to override the display label per item while the link target remains the page path.

name: Truncation handling
designDescription: Long labels truncated or wrapped
developmentDescription: Responsive text handling
assumptions: Truncate breadcrumb item text beyond a configured character limit with CSS ellipsis.

name: Ellipsis breadcrumbs
designDescription: Middle items collapsed
developmentDescription: Item hiding and expansion logic
assumptions: Collapse middle breadcrumb items beyond a configured count; expand on user interaction.

name: Icon-only root
designDescription: Home icon as first item
developmentDescription: Icon rendering logic
assumptions: Replace root breadcrumb item text with a home icon. Icon asset configured via dialog.

name: Clickable items
designDescription: All items except current page clickable
developmentDescription: Link resolution
assumptions: Render all breadcrumb items as anchor links resolved from the AEM page path.

name: Non-clickable items
designDescription: Breadcrumbs used for context only
developmentDescription: Disabled link rendering
assumptions: Allow authors to mark individual items as non-clickable (plain text, no anchor link).

name: Current page state
designDescription: Final item visually highlighted
developmentDescription: Active state logic
assumptions: Apply active CSS class to the last breadcrumb item (current page). Current page item has no link.

name: Custom click behaviour
designDescription: Scroll or JS-triggered actions
developmentDescription: Event handling logic
assumptions: Attach custom event handler (e.g. analytics push, SPA route) to breadcrumb link clicks.

name: Background container
designDescription: Breadcrumbs inside container bar
developmentDescription: Container layout logic
assumptions: Wrap breadcrumb in a styled container. Background colour and padding controlled via CSS policies.

name: Mobile truncation
designDescription: Reduced breadcrumb items on mobile
developmentDescription: Breakpoint logic
assumptions: Collapse breadcrumb to show only first and last items on mobile breakpoint.

name: Scrollable breadcrumbs
designDescription: Horizontal scroll on small screens
developmentDescription: Overflow handling
assumptions: Enable horizontal scroll on overflow when breadcrumb items exceed container width on small screens.

name: Hide on mobile
designDescription: Breadcrumbs removed on small screens
developmentDescription: Conditional rendering
assumptions: Hide entire breadcrumb component on mobile breakpoint via CSS display policy.

name: Responsive separators
designDescription: Separator changes by breakpoint
developmentDescription: Responsive styling logic
assumptions: Configure separator character or icon between breadcrumb items. Separator adjusts or hides on mobile.

name: Simple header (link navigation)
designDescription: Header displays logo and a linear set of navigation links with clear hierarchy and hover/active states.
developmentDescription: Static navigation structure with direct link routing and active state handling.
assumptions: Static navigation with logo, link items, active state handling, and responsive collapse. No dynamic data.

name: Simple header with CTAs (search, cart, account, wishlist, etc)

developmentDescription: Navigation rendering with integrated CTAs component and routing logic.

name: Sticky Simple header
designDescription: Header remains visible on scroll with defined compact or fixed behaviour.
developmentDescription: Scroll-based positioning logic with state handling for sticky behaviour.

name: Language Selector (dropdown, flags, or simple text)
designDescription: Header includes a language selector displaying available languages as text links or short language codes.
developmentDescription: Language selector renders available locales and routes users to corresponding language pages.

name: Expandable animation on header
designDescription: Header supports an expandable or collapsible visual state (e.g. expanding height, revealing secondary content) with clear motion behaviour.
developmentDescription: Header includes expandable state logic with animation handling, state transitions, and accessibility‑compliant toggle behaviour.

name: Simple header on burger menu sidebar / OR / full pop up
designDescription: Navigation is hidden by default and revealed via a burger menu, displayed as a sidebar or full‑screen overlay with defined layout and hierarchy.
developmentDescription: Burger menu interaction logic with off‑canvas or modal navigation rendering, open/close state management, and focus handling.

name: Animations on hover states
designDescription: Navigation links and interactive elements include hover animations aligned with motion and brand guidelines.
developmentDescription: CSS or JS hover animations applied to navigation elements, ensuring performance, accessibility, and consistency across devices.

name: Links have an icon
designDescription: Navigation links include leading or trailing icons to support recognition and visual hierarchy, with consistent alignment, spacing, and hover behaviour.
developmentDescription: Navigation supports icon rendering alongside link labels, including icon asset handling, alignment logic, and accessibility considerations (ARIA labels where required).

name: Links open an external link

developmentDescription: Navigation supports external link handling, including target behaviour (new tab), optional external indicators, security attributes, and accessibility labelling.

name: Multi‑header (audience / brand selector)

developmentDescription: Context selection logic with state persistence and coordination with mega navigation structure.

name: Complex header with mega navigation
designDescription: Header includes multi‑level navigation where top‑level links trigger large dropdown panels displaying grouped navigation options.
developmentDescription: Dynamic mega menu structure with multi‑level navigation logic, open/close state handling, and routing management.

name: Mega menu with multiple columns
designDescription: Mega menu panels are laid out in multiple columns to present navigation groups clearly and scannably.
developmentDescription: Layout logic supports configurable column structures and responsive reflow.

name: Mega menu with content blocks
designDescription: Mega menu panels include non‑link content such as images, promotional blocks or featured sections.
developmentDescription: Mega menu supports mixed content rendering alongside navigation links, including layout and data modelling.

name: Mega menu with CTAs
designDescription: Mega menu includes one or more CTAs styled according to the design system and visually separated from navigation links.
developmentDescription: CTA components are supported within mega menu panels, with routing, tracking, and interaction handling.

name: Mega menu hover interaction
designDescription: Mega menu panels open on hover with defined delay, animation and hover intent behaviour.

name: Mega menu click interaction
designDescription: Mega menu panels open on click for improved usability and accessibility.
developmentDescription: Click‑based toggle logic with state persistence and close‑on‑outside‑click handling.

name: Sticky complex header
designDescription: Header and mega navigation remain visible on scroll with defined compact or fixed behaviour.
developmentDescription: Scroll‑based positioning logic with coordination between sticky header and mega menu states.

name: Mobile mega navigation
designDescription: Mega menu adapts to mobile as a stacked, accordion, or drill‑down navigation pattern.
developmentDescription: Mobile‑specific navigation logic with hierarchical transitions and back‑navigation handling.

name: Expandable animation on mega menu
designDescription: Mega menu panels include open/close animations aligned with motion and brand guidelines.
developmentDescription: Animation handling for mega menu transitions, respecting reduced‑motion preferences and accessibility.

name: Links have an icon
designDescription: Navigation links include icons to support visual hierarchy and content recognition within the mega menu.
developmentDescription: Icon rendering is supported in navigation items with alignment logic and accessibility considerations.

name: Links open an external link
designDescription: Mega menu links visually indicate external destinations where required, without disrupting hierarchy or usability.
developmentDescription: External link handling supported, including target behaviour, indicators, security attributes, and accessibility labelling.

name: Language selector in complex header
designDescription: Language selector is integrated into the complex header or mega menu layout with clear active state.
developmentDescription: Language selector logic integrated alongside mega navigation without interaction conflicts.

name: Multi‑header (audience / brand selector)
designDescription: Header includes an additional bar allowing users to switch audience, brand, or regional context.
developmentDescription: Context selection logic with state persistence and coordination with mega navigation structure.

name: Contextual mega navigation

developmentDescription: Conditional rendering logic connects selected context to navigation configuration.

name: Search input in header

developmentDescription: Client‑side or persisted state handling for search history.

name: Popular / suggested searches
designDescription: Suggested searches are displayed to guide users before typing.

name: Standard list (AEM Core Component defaults)
designDescription: Uses standard AEM List patterns and styles. Minimal design input limited to spacing, typography, and alignment within the design system. No bespoke visual treatment.
developmentDescription: Configuration-only. Content selection via children, tags, or static paths. Uses out-of-the-box Core Component functionality with no custom logic.

name: Content-driven list (by tags, children, or search)
designDescription: Design focuses on content hierarchy, truncation rules, metadata display (e.g. title, description, date). Responsive behaviour defined but consistent with existing patterns.
developmentDescription: Configure list data source logic. Ensure correct use of Core Component options (tags, children depth, sorting). Minimal backend logic.

name: List with item variants (e.g. compact / detailed)
designDescription: Defines visual variants for list items (e.g. compact vs detailed view). Rules established for what metadata appears per variant.

name: List with basic icon or thumbnail
designDescription: Adds small icons or thumbnails to list items using existing DAM assets and predefined aspect ratios. No complex media behaviour.
developmentDescription: Leverages Core Component image handling. Minor front-end adjustments to support thumbnail placement and fallbacks.

name: Custom card-based list
designDescription: Fully bespoke card design including imagery, metadata, CTAs, and hover states. Not achievable through Core styles alone. Requires custom layouts and visual states.

name: List with advanced filtering (client-side)
designDescription: Design includes interactive filtering controls (e.g. dropdowns, checkboxes) and visual states for filtered results. UX flows defined.
developmentDescription: Front-end filtering using JavaScript. Data exposed via component model; no search backend integration. Performance considerations required.

name: List with pagination or load more
designDescription: Defines pagination or “load more” UX patterns and states including loading and empty states.
developmentDescription: Requires custom backend handling or APIs. Integration with pagination logic and possible search endpoints. Increased complexity.

name: Editorial or curated list
designDescription: Highly curated presentation with conditional rules per item (e.g. featured item styling). Visual emphasis rules defined by design.
developmentDescription: Custom authoring logic for item ordering and overrides. Additional validation and rendering logic.

name: Standard image (AEM Core Component defaults)
designDescription: Uses default image styles from the design system. Design input limited to alignment, spacing, and responsive behaviour within existing layouts.
developmentDescription: Out-of-the-box Core Image Component. Configuration-only with standard DAM asset usage, no custom logic.

name: Image with caption
designDescription: Defines typography, spacing, and placement rules for caption text relative to the image. Responsive behaviour specified.
developmentDescription: Uses Core Component caption field. Minimal front-end adjustments for layout consistency.

name: Responsive image (breakpoints / aspect ratios)
designDescription: Design defines how the image crops or scales across breakpoints and aspect ratios. Ensures visual integrity across devices.
developmentDescription: Core Component responsive image behaviour configured via policies. No custom media logic.

name: Image with basic CTA overlay

developmentDescription: Light extension of Core Component using CSS and HTL structure. No custom authoring logic.

name: Decorative vs editorial image usage

developmentDescription: Configuration and authoring guidance. Front-end enforces alt text behaviour where applicable.

name: Custom image layout or framing
designDescription: Bespoke visual treatments such as masks, shapes, or overlapping layouts that are not supported by Core styles.
developmentDescription: Custom component build. Bespoke HTL and CSS styling required. May still reference DAM delivery.

name: Image with complex overlay content
designDescription: Rich overlays including text blocks, CTAs, icons, and multiple states (hover/focus). Requires detailed UX definition.
developmentDescription: Custom component with structured authoring fields and conditional rendering. Increased front-end complexity.

name: Image with animation or interaction
designDescription: Defines image transitions, parallax, or scroll-based animations. Motion design and performance considerations included.

name: Dynamic image variants (contextual)

name: Art-directed responsive images

name: Standard carousel (AEM Core defaults)

name: Carousel with indicators (dots, numbers)
designDescription: Defines visual treatment, placement, and active/inactive states for slide indicators. Accessibility considerations included.
developmentDescription: Uses Core Component indicator options. Minor CSS adjustments only.

name: Carousel with navigation controls (prev/next)
designDescription: Design defines control placement, iconography, hover/focus states, and responsive behaviour.
developmentDescription: Core navigation controls enabled via configuration. No custom JS required.

name: Auto-rotating carousel

developmentDescription: Core auto-play configuration. Uses existing rotation settings and policies.

name: Mixed content carousel (images, text, components)
designDescription: Design defines how different content types behave within slides. Consistency rules set for spacing, height, and alignment.
developmentDescription: Uses allowed components within Core Carousel. No custom component logic required.

name: Carousel with fixed height or aspect ratio
designDescription: Design specifies consistent height or aspect ratio across slides to reduce layout shift.

name: Custom carousel layout

developmentDescription: Custom component build or significant extension of Core Carousel. Custom HTL and CSS required.

name: Carousel with advanced animation

developmentDescription: Custom JavaScript animation logic. Performance and accessibility considerations required.

name: Standard container (fixed width)

developmentDescription: Out‑of‑the‑box Core Container component. Configuration only.

name: Full‑width container

developmentDescription: Core Container with full‑width styling applied via CSS and policies.

name: Fixed layout splits (50/50, 60/40, 40/60)

name: Banner container with background image
